description: This file defines the AdoNetClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements configuration logic for ADO.NET clustering providers in Orleans, including methods to configure silo and client builders with connection settings.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A sealed internal class implementing provider builder interfaces for silo and client, configuring ADO.NET clustering options based on configuration sections.

methods.name: Configure (ISiloBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use ADO.NET clustering with connection options derived from the configuration section.

methods.name: Configure (IClientBuilder, string, IConfigurationSection)
methods.description: Configures the client builder to use ADO.NET clustering with connection options derived from the configuration section.
